Curated Collective Market @ Georgian Mall

Is your brand ready to be showcased in a space that reflects its true value?
Welcome to Curated Collective Market at Georgian Mall, Barrie; an elevated, intentionally curated marketplace featuring a select group of local brands across fashion, beauty, lifestyle, and gifting.
This is not an open market. It’s a refined retail experience where presentation, quality, and brand alignment matter.
For Vendors | This is for you if:
You’ve invested in your brand and product quality
You value how your business is presented
You want to be positioned alongside like-minded, elevated brands
Expect more than foot traffic, expect meaningful visibility and connection.
Event Details:
📅 Saturday, September 12, 2026 🕘 9:30 AM – 6:00 PM
📅 Sunday, September 13, 2026 🕘 11:00 AM – 5:00 PM
📍 Georgian Mall, Barrie
Vendor Applications | We are selectively curating this market.
If your brand aligns with a premium, cohesive experience, we invite you to apply:
👉https://forms.gle/4ZfWL8uY6kbUwAfk9
📧 [email protected]
For Guests
Discover a curated collection of standout local brands and enjoy an elevated shopping experience.
